title: Taken over in place
subtitle: This run does not copy data. Tugra starts next to Coolify on the same machine, checks every site, then takes the ports.
badgeHint: Same machine, no data copy: Coolify stays on the server until you remove it, and giving it back is one click.
unreadable: The takeover could not be read. Try again.

outcome.rebuilding: Rebuilding with Tugra, not verified yet
outcome.rebuilt_check_failed: Rebuilt with Tugra, but a domain does not answer like Coolify's copy
outcome.rebuild_failed: The rebuild with Tugra failed, so the app is left out
outcome.rebuild_declined: Rebuild asked for, but it shares data with Coolify's copy, so it reuses the image
outcome.database: Database, taken over on its own data

DEPLOY_DARK.planned: In place: the takeover is planned from what Coolify runs. Nothing was changed.
DEPLOY_DARK.tested: In place: Tugra's proxy runs with no public port and every site was checked on it.
DEPLOY_DARK.done: In place: the test beside Coolify passed.
DEPLOY_DARK.gaveBack: In place: Tugra stopped and Coolify serves the sites as before.
DEPLOY_DARK.failed: In place: the test did not finish. Coolify still serves the sites.

VERIFY.review: In place: review the test, then approve to take the ports.

CUTOVER.swapping: In place: handing the ports over. This takes a minute.
CUTOVER.swapped: In place: Tugra serves the sites. It is getting a new certificate for each domain.
CUTOVER.verified: In place: every site works and has a new certificate.
CUTOVER.gaveBack: In place: given back, Coolify serves the sites again.
CUTOVER.failed: In place: the switch did not finish and was put back.

appsEmpty: Your apps appear here once Tugra has read them from Coolify. Nothing is changed before that.
banner: Coolify keeps serving your sites until you approve. One click gives it back.

reason.status_only: The two answer the same status; the page content was not compared.
reason.preexisting: Coolify's copy already answered like this before the move.
reason.unreachable: Tugra's copy could not be reached.
reason.server_error: Tugra's copy answers with an error.
reason.status_differs: The two answer with a different status.
reason.content_differs: The two answer with different content.
reason.not_ready: The app's container is not up yet.

step.DEPLOY_DARK: Test every site next to Coolify

next.connect: Tugra needs a connection to Coolify
next.readyBody: Nothing on your server changes yet. Tugra reads your apps from Coolify and tests every site next to it, and asks for your go-ahead before it takes anything over.
next.waitNote: Nothing is needed from you. You can close this page.
next.timerNote: Watching your sites, nothing needed from you. You can close this page.
next.failedHintSafe: Nothing was lost: Coolify still serves your sites.
next.failedHintSwitched: Your sites stay up while this is sorted out. Try again, or give Coolify back.

app.live_cert: Live on Tugra, certificate on its way
app.database: Database, taken over on its own data

gate.acmeEmail: This server has no email address for its certificates, so Tugra cannot get new ones. Set the Let's Encrypt email for this server, then check again.

giveBack.title: Give Coolify back?
giveBack.body: Tugra stops and Coolify serves your sites again. Nothing is lost.
giveBack.hint: Coolify can be given back with one click until you clean it up.

approval.sitesSame: All {count} sites answer the same through Tugra as through Coolify.
approval.sitesSameOne: Your site answers the same through Tugra as through Coolify.
approval.leftOut: Left out of the move, Coolify keeps running them:
approval.takes: Taking over takes about a minute. Coolify can be given back with one click.
approval.confirmBody: Tugra takes the ports and serves your sites. Coolify can be given back with one click.
approval.askUnknown: A finding you need to confirm

done.body: {sites} sites answer like before and have a certificate.
